# 2 Clement — Chapter 7 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 7
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Brothers, let us get into the race. We know the contest is coming. People travel great distances to compete in games that offer prizes that will rot away — and even then, not all of them win. Only those who train hard and compete well receive the crown.
2. So let us compete so that we can all be crowned.
3. Let us run straight toward the imperishable contest. Let many of us come together and enter it, so that we too may be crowned. And if we cannot all win, let us at least press close to the prize.
4. Consider this: an athlete who cheats in an ordinary competition gets beaten, thrown out, and banned from the arena.
5. So what do you think will happen to the person who cheats in the contest for eternal life?
6. About those who have not kept the seal, scripture says: "Their worm will not die, their fire will not be put out, and they will be a sight for all flesh to see."
